description: Main house: 6 ppl Optional studio apt. (additional $250/night): 2 additional pplA minimalist retreat maximizing views (inside and out), comfort, privacy, & tranquility. Main floor opens to a salt-water 15 x 18 double-edge infinity pool and deck. Solar energy, fully filtered water, 300 Mbps high-speed wifi, and high efficiency fixtures ensure consistent as possible comfort and connectivity within the fluctuations of island life. Private balconies and en suite baths in each bedroom.The spaceCasa Paz is a haven of architectural ambition, art, amenities and relaxation. Guests can be as connected or secluded as they wish at this resort-like, 1-acre property for a few as 4 nights or a long as a month. Unique design and comfort were curated equally to create a zen-like space for all guests. Surfers, beach goers, creatives, and lovers of island life will each enjoy Casa Paz's beauty and Puntas location, from which several swimming and surfing beaches are only 5-minutes away by car. (See more location information below.)The open-concept main levels offers:- an interior living room with a smart TV and ceiling fan- an interior reading lounge with a ceiling fan- custom crafted, fully equipped concrete kitchen with a breakfast bar- outdoor dining space- two-sided shaded pool deck with loungers and overhead fansThree sets of accordion doors retract to create an almost total indoor/outdoor experience and make the most of the tropical breezes and trade winds. (Downstairs does not have AC)The second level has three bedrooms, each with a private balcony, en-suite full bathroom, ACs, and fans. All are stocked with premium cotton linens. Eco-friendly Native shampoo, conditioner, and body wash are provided. In the main bedroom, valley and Aguadilla Bay views are visible from the king bed, shower, and custom tub. Bathing turns into an open-air experience when the doors are open. (Private water closet for toilet.)A walk-in wardrobe closet leaves plenty of space for luggage and hanging items. The two guest bedrooms have their own unique view from queen beds and individual balconies. Frosted windows provide privacy, but can also be opened for views. A recessed closet space in each provides room for luggage, plus folded and hanging items. The salt-water pool has a large semi-submerged sun deck with two chairs, a lounge bench, and light for night swimming. The infinity edges drop to 10 foot water walls. The exterior of the property has dense tropical landscaping (photos to come), amongst which there are: - spacious private parking- a 10 x 15 yoga platform - two outdoor showers/rinse stations- board storage- fire pit and chill lounge on the lowest levelGuests are permitted use of the washer/dryer (please see notes below). A full solar energy system powers the entire house (please see solar use notes below). Fully-filtered well water provides potable water from the faucets and eliminates the need for plastic bottles. 300 mbps high speed Wifi is available throughout the property, including lounge decks and balconies. A studio apartment is available as an add-on for a group of 8 people or for groups of fewer than 8 people who would like more space. $250/night + $75 cleaning fee. LocationPerched high in Puntas, Casa Paz is still just minutes from all of Rincon and the NW corner's attractions. Antonio's, Parking Lots, and Sandy beaches are a 5-minute drive from the house. Domes, Maria's, Marina, and the Rincon Balneario are 10-minutes. Aguadilla's Survival and Surfer's beaches are 20-30 minutes. Isabela's Jobos Beach is 45 minutes. Downtown Rincon is 10-15 minutes and you are never far from a restaurant, no matter where you may be in town. Owner's NoteWe hope our guests enjoy and appreciate the love, care, and talent that came together to make this house a home to share. If you are curious about any of the design features or art, we are happy to provide names of the designers, craftsman, and artists who made it all come to life.Guest accessCasa Paz is available to rent in two modules, though only to one group at a time. Option 1: A three-bedroom, 3 1/2 bath home with access to the upper two floors, all exterior spaces.Option 2: Add-on rental of studio apartment on the lowest level for $250/night + $75 cleaning fee. The studio would allow for an occupancy of 8 people.Other things to notePool Guests must use caution when using the pool. No children left unattended. No glass cups or bottles near or in the pool. If any glass breaks near or in the pool, the guest will be responsible for the cost to empty, clean, and refill the pool.Pool is cleaned and serviced every Wednesday. This is a standard cleaning by our trusted service provider. On occasion, he will need to enter through the house. He will be informed about guests and will knock before entering. Otherwise, he enters through the planter box on the left side of the house. Sunlight and ViewsThe windows and doors at Casa Paz maximize views and the indoor/outdoor concept. For those who are more light sensitive or would like to make some space between inside and outside, there are sleeping masks provided. Please note the main en-suite bathroom is adjacent to a 22’ wide glass door. Please reference the bedroom photos in the profile if you have any concerns about the rooms' exposure to sunlight. Solar energyThe solar system is meant to power the entire home. To help it run most efficiently and keep you comfortable, please observe the following: - Keep bedroom doors closed while ACS are running- Turn off all lights when leaving the home. ACs can actually stay on at 24 degrees.- On very cloudy days, monitor use of ACs and fans - In the event of several consecutive, cloudy days, the more mindful we are of electrical use, the better the battery back up power will be for use. - Please do not touch or manipulate any of the solar equipment in the laundry roomFront door The large yellow pivot door is a bit sticky when opening and closing. This is to help prevent it from swinging open with heavier winds. However, we suggest keeping the door bolted when inside the house to prevent it moving too much. You will find a key hanging on the wall next to the door. Please use that key to secure the door when inside. Neighborhood There is an older local resident who you will see walking throughout the neighborhood with a cup of coffee. He may stop and speak in your direction without any need for or expectation of a response. He lives just up the road in a small home and is routinely cared for by family. He will occasionally go through the trash bins, which is why we have bungee cords on them (please fasten these when putting trash in the bin). He is harmless. This neighborhood was his home before it was any of ours.Laundry The laundry room is located on the right side of the house, lower level, if looking at it from the front yard. The laundry room door key is attached to the main key.
